purpose: Clear, warm female explainer at normal speaking pace; teaching a mixed high-school and undergraduate audience, not announcing.
identity_source: Kokoro-82M built-in preset voice af_heart. No real-person clone, and no conditioning prompt.

selection.method: chosen by ear from six Kokoro female presets speaking one identical passage; one variable (the voice), same seed, same speed, loudness-matched to -25.28 LUFS before listening
rejected_alternatives: af_nicole (American, 161 Hz, 117 wpm -- markedly slower at the same speed=1.0)
bf_alice (British, 213 Hz, 71 Hz F0 IQR -- widest pitch spread, and band-limited to 10 kHz)
warm-natural (Chatterbox, male, 108 Hz) -- rejected for this film but kept as an option by the user

acoustic_policy.optional_speech_restoration: MossFormer2_SR_48K TESTED and REJECTED by ear on 2026-08-21. It passed duration, F0 and bandwidth checks and raised energy above 12 kHz from 1.2% to 12.9%, with zero WER change. The listener still preferred the plain 48 kHz resample. Do not apply it to this voice by default.

known_limits: Kokoro outputs 24 kHz, so there is zero energy above 12 kHz. The band-limit is measured, not theoretical -- and on this voice the listener preferred it to restoration.
No EQ curve has been established for this voice. Do NOT paste the warm-natural curve onto it; that curve is profile-specific and was measured on a male voice an octave lower.
Speed must stay at 1.0 for this profile. deep-onyx-slow's 0.78 is a different profile's decision.
install_notes: Kokoro will not pip-install on Python 3.13 via its own dependency chain (spacy/thinc have no cp313 wheels). Install spacy alone first, then `pip install --no-deps kokoro misaki`, then loguru num2words phonemizer-fork espeakng-loader. Point phonemizer at the bundled espeak library before constructing KPipeline or G2P returns None phonemes for out-of-dictionary words.
notes: Selected 2026-08-21 for the Doppler cooling / MOT explainer.
Film-specific seeds and takes live with that film's production record, not here.
